detail.longDescription:
Ideal for iPhone owners who want to mirror their screen, cast web videos, and share photos or videos on a compatible Smart TV. Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV delivers fast, ad-free, low-latency casting without Apple TV, HDMI cables, extra hardware, or signing in to TV apps.
Join more than 12.5 million users who bring their favorite iPhone content to the big screen.

BEST FOR
• Watching anime, web videos, and streams not available in native TV apps
• Mirroring presentations, documents, apps, and websites
• Sharing family photos and home videos on a larger display
• Casting to hotel TVs while traveling without signing in on the TV

KEY FEATURES
◆ SCREEN MIRRORING
Mirror your entire iPhone display to your TV in real time — run presentations without a projector, show games on a larger screen, or browse the web on your TV from the comfort of your couch.

◆ WEB VIDEO CAST
Use the built-in browser to find and cast online videos directly to your TV. Watch YouTube, anime, web series, news, live streams, and other supported content — all controlled from your iPhone.

◆ PHOTO & VIDEO CASTING
Cast photos and videos from your iPhone gallery to your Smart TV. Share vacation memories, family milestones, and home videos together on the big screen.

◆ AD-FREE, SMOOTH STREAMING
The app is ad-free and optimized for fast connection and minimal delay, helping you stay focused on your content without interruptions.

HOW TO CONNECT IPHONE TO TV
• Connect your iPhone and Smart TV to the same Wi-Fi network
• Open the app and tap “Connect TV”
• Select your TV from the available devices
• Choose Screen Mirroring, Web Video, Photos, Videos, or Live Camera

COMPATIBLE TVS & DEVICES
• Samsung Smart TVs
• LG Smart TVs
• Roku players and Roku TVs
• Amazon Fire TV and Fire TV Stick
• Google Chromecast
• Vizio Smart TVs
• Other compatible Smart TVs with Wi-Fi casting support

Compatibility may vary by TV model and supported casting technology.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I mirror my iPhone to a Samsung TV?
Yes. Connect to a compatible Samsung Smart TV over Wi-Fi to mirror your iPhone screen or cast content. No Samsung account or extra hardware required.

Does it work with Roku?
Yes. Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV supports compatible Roku players and Roku TVs. Connect your iPhone and Roku to the same Wi-Fi network and select your device in the app.

Can I cast YouTube or anime videos?
Yes. The built-in Web Video Cast lets you cast supported videos from YouTube, anime sites, news sites, live streams, and other websites directly to your TV.

Can I use Screen Mirroring | Cast to TV in a hotel while traveling?
Yes, if your iPhone and compatible TV are on the same Wi-Fi network. Some hotel or public Wi-Fi networks may block connections between devices.

Can I cast family photos and videos from my iPhone to my TV?
Yes. Cast photos, vacation videos, kids’ milestones, and other memories from your iPhone to a compatible Smart TV so everyone can watch together.

Does screen mirroring require Apple TV?
No. Compatible Smart TVs and streaming devices connect directly over Wi-Fi without Apple TV, HDMI cables, or extra hardware.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscriptions are billed to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings.
